turns.text: The sergeant at arms is directed to make a proclamation.

turns.speaker: Alfredo Sotto Corpuz
turns.text: All persons are commanded to keep silent under pain of penalty while the impeachment court is in session for the trial of Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: The impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte is hereby called to order.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: We shall be led in prayer by Senator-Judge Christopher Bong Go.

turns.speaker: Sen. Christopher Bong Go
turns.text: Let us put ourselves in the presence of the Lord.

turns.speaker: Sen. Christopher Bong Go
turns.text: Almighty God, we come before you today seeking your wisdom, guidance, and strength as we fulfill the duties entrusted to us by the Filipino people. We pray for the peaceful conduct of the ongoing BARM elections and and for the continued success of the Bangsamoro Peace Process. Matagal nang pinagdadaanan ng ating mga kapatid sa Bangsamoro ang landas tungo sa kapayapaan. Naway magiging pagkakataon ng halalan upang mas marinig ang boses ng taong bayan at lalo pang mapagtibay ang kapayapaan, pagkakaisa, at pagunlad sa rehyon. Kami rin po ay pinili ng taong bayan upang maging kanilang mga kinatawan. Nawa'y huwag naming sayangin ang tiwalang ipinagkaloob nila sa amin sapagkat sa aming mga disisyon ay nakasalalay hindi lamang ang kasalukuyan kundi maging ang kinabukasan ng ating bansa at ng mga susunod na henerasyon. In this important moment for our nation, grant us clarity of mind and sincerity of heart. May we always be guided by truth, fairness, respect for our institutions, and above all, the welfare of every Filipino. Lord, as we perform our solemn duty as Senator-Judges, remind us that the credibility and integrity of this Court rests upon how faithfully and fairly we discharge our responsibilities. Tayo ang pinili at pinagkatiwalaan ng mahalagang tungkulin ito, naway maging patas at makatarungan kami sa bawat hakbang at disisyon aming gagawin. Lord, We also pray for our countrymen who continue to face the daily struggles of life sa gitna ng hirap ng buhay, pagtaas ng mga bilihin, mga sakuna, at iba pang pagsubok. Tulungan mo kaming huwag malimutan ang tunay na dahilan ng aming paglilingkod, ang mapabuti ang buhay ng bawat Pilipino. May this process never divide us as a nation, sa halip naway manaig ang ating pagkakabuklod-buklod Pagalang sa isa't isa at pagmamalasakit sa kapwa. I am for unity. I am for healing of this country. Sana matapos na ito para makatrabaho na tayo. Remind us that beyond our positions and responsibilities, we share one country and one responsibility to protect its people in its future. Guide each one of us to act according to our conscience, the Constitution, and the rule of law. Give us the humility to listen, the courage to do what is right, and the wisdom to place the interests of the Filipino people above all else. May our decisions contribute to a stronger, more peaceful, more united, and healed Philippines. All these we ask in your holy name. Amen.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Of course. Please proceed with your redirect, Atty. James.

turns.speaker: Atty. James Bryan Ibrahim A. Alih
turns.text: Maraming salamat po.

turns.speaker: Atty. James Bryan Ibrahim A. Alih
turns.text: Madam Witness, I just have probably

turns.speaker: Atty. James Bryan Ibrahim A. Alih
turns.text: two questions.

turns.speaker: Atty. James Bryan Ibrahim A. Alih
turns.text: Nakita niyo po yung mga SAL-Ns na pinakita kanina sa inyo. From... I forgot the years. But anyway, these are previous forms of the SAL-N. At ang tanong po sa inyo kanina ay wala pong line item na cash. Tama po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Karen S. Batu
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Atty. James Bryan Ibrahim A. Alih
turns.text: Meron din po bang line... Looking back at those SAL-Ns, what other line items is contained there?

turns.speaker: Atty. James Bryan Ibrahim A. Alih
turns.text: If you recall, unless we can show it again. If you can show it again po, please.

turns.speaker: Atty. Karen S. Batu
turns.text: Based po dun sa kakakita ko lang ng mga documents, wala namang pong line item. So,

turns.speaker: Atty. James Bryan Ibrahim A. Alih
turns.text: walang line item for cars?

turns.speaker: Atty. Karen S. Batu
turns.text: Wala po.

turns.speaker: Atty. James Bryan Ibrahim A. Alih
turns.text: Walang line item for jewelries?

turns.speaker: Atty. Karen S. Batu
turns.text: Wala din po.

turns.speaker: Atty. James Bryan Ibrahim A. Alih
turns.text: So, ibig sabihin di na kailangan i-declare yan kasi walang line item eh. Tama po ba yan? Or you would not know that answer?

turns.speaker: Atty. Karen S. Batu
turns.text: Again, based po dun sa nabasa ko, nakalagay doon na kailangan i-declare yung mga personal properties na in-itemize doon.

turns.speaker: Atty. James Bryan Ibrahim A. Alih
turns.text: Okay. So, that's fine, Madam Witness. I won't go further with that.

turns.speaker: Atty. James Bryan Ibrahim A. Alih
turns.text: You also mentioned about the correction. There's a corrective measure. And we also want to be fair with the Vice President. There is a way for her to correct the silence. But I remember... Kanina nung direct examination niyo, you mentioned that once those documents or SAL-Ns have already been forwarded to you by the head of the agency or whatever corresponding body that would forward it, what is the effect of those SAL-Ns once they are forwarded to you by the heads of agencies, if there are any?

turns.speaker: Atty. Karen S. Batu
turns.text: Deemed filed na po iyon pag na-e-forward sa repository agency. So tinatanggap po namin yung mga SAL-Ns na binigay ng agency according to the stated deadline. At

turns.speaker: Atty. James Bryan Ibrahim A. Alih
turns.text: sinabi niyo po kanina na hindi na pwedeng i-correct kasi nasa sa inyo na. Tama po ba yun?

turns.speaker: Atty. Karen S. Batu
turns.text: That's under the omnibus

turns.speaker: Atty. James Bryan Ibrahim A. Alih
turns.text: guidelines. Okay, that's fine. That's fair. But also, to be fair to the Vice President, there's a succeeding paragraph, hindi po ba? Ang sinasabi noon, And I'm sorry or I'm just recalling this from memory. I don't have that on screen. Ang sinasabi doon that the subsequent filing of the SALNs would constitute a correction if there are any corrections at all. That's correct, right?

turns.speaker: Atty. Karen S. Batu
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. James Bryan Ibrahim A. Alih
turns.text: But going through all the SALNs during the direct examination and based on your records, was there a corrected SALN by the Vice President?

turns.speaker: Atty. Karen S. Batu
turns.text: Doon po sa sinubmit namin sa inyo, lahat po yun parang SAL-N for the one for each year. So wala naman po akong nakitang corrected SAL-N.

turns.speaker: Atty. James Bryan Ibrahim A. Alih
turns.text: But also to be fair to the Vice President, there was one, tama po ba, nung nabanggit po ng ating kagalang-galang na presiding officer na may correction on some clerical or if not minor matters. Tama po yan, tama.

turns.speaker: Atty. Karen S. Batu
turns.text: That was not forwarded to us so I cannot confirm. Anyway,

turns.speaker: Atty. James Bryan Ibrahim A. Alih
turns.text: but Based on your records, there was no corrected. And this is what you're saying a while ago. There was no SAL-N insofar as correction is concerned.

turns.speaker: Atty. Karen S. Batu
turns.text: As I've said kanina, meron for 2025.

turns.speaker: Atty. James Bryan Ibrahim A. Alih
turns.text: Okay. So, based on your testimony now, lahat po ng SAL-N na nakita nyo, Are the true and accurate SAL-Ns based on your records by the Vice President?

turns.speaker: Atty. Karen S. Batu
turns.text: Yes, sa official records po namin nakukuha lahat ng submitted SAL-Ns.

turns.speaker: Atty. James Bryan Ibrahim A. Alih
turns.text: I'm on my last point, Madam Witness. And hopefully, I think we're about to end early also today.

turns.speaker: Atty. James Bryan Ibrahim A. Alih
turns.text: You mentioned that you had no personal knowledge, although that wasn't an issue, but we've given leeway to the good counsel. You mentioned that you had no personal knowledge. On the SAL-Ns, and you just merely based your testimony today on the records that you have. Tama po yun?

turns.speaker: Atty. Karen S. Batu
turns.text: Tama po. Lahat mo nang binanggit ko, based lang po dun sa nakasulat na SAL-Ns. Pero,

turns.speaker: Atty. James Bryan Ibrahim A. Alih

turns.speaker: Atty. Karen S. Batu
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. James Bryan Ibrahim A. Alih
turns.text: And who again makes that oath?

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Asked and answered, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. James Bryan Ibrahim A. Alih
turns.text: By the own admission of the counsel, he asked it during the hearing.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Let's let him wind up, counsel. We will.

turns.speaker: Atty. James Bryan Ibrahim A. Alih
turns.text: Again, Madam Witness, sinabi niyo po that SAL-Ns are declared under oath. So my question is this, just to clarify what our friends from the defense was asking a while ago. Who again swears when they filed a SAL-N?

turns.text: The declarant po.

turns.text: In all the SAL-Ns of the Vice President, who is the declarant there?

turns.speaker: Atty. Karen S. Batu
turns.text: The Vice President herself.

turns.speaker: Atty. James Bryan Ibrahim A. Alih
turns.text: Therefore, he attests that those are true and correct. Tama po ba? Based sa records at based sa rules.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. James Bryan Ibrahim A. Alih
turns.text: That would be all, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Manuel “Lito” M. Lapid

turns.text: Thank you, Senator-Judge Lapid. Senator-Judge Erwin Tulfo is recognized.

turns.text: mga na-omit o hindi sinagutan ng mga portions, paano ho ito?

turns.text: Kung may mga na-umit po, hindi rin po talaga namin malalaman kung meron siyang dapat i-declare doon or wala. Ang tinitingnan lang po namin talaga kung tama yung form na ginamit, napirmahan, dated, tapos paginated. Okay. Kung sa kasakaling

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: makita ninyo na may mali, alright? Very glaring yung mali.

turns.speaker: Atty. Karen S. Batu
turns.text: Ang field investigation office po namin, yun po yung mga nagkakondak ng fact-finding investigation. Pero wala po silang access sa mga saliens na sinasubmit sa amin unless magre-request po sila for purposes of conducting the fact-finding investigation.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: During your stint with the ombudsman, wala pa po bang naimbestigahan? or pinaimbestigahan ng inyong unit repository na may duda kayo sa SALN? Wala pa bang ganun kayong nalalaman since kayo pumasok dyan sa Ombudsman?

turns.text: May mga kaso na po kasi nakarating naman na po ng Supreme Court, Sandiganbayan. So mayroon po mga kaso ang Office of the Ombudsman na inimbestigahan ng mga... Public Officials dahil sa mga Sal-Ns nila.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Paano po nahalongkat yun? Through your office or because may nagsumbong, may nag-report? Is that what it is?

turns.speaker: Atty. Karen S. Batu
turns.text: Usually po, Your Honor, meron po nagsusumbong. Kadalasan po usually mga anonymous complaints.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Okay, panguli na lamang po. Sa inyo po nakita dahil kayo po nagdala nung Sal-N-EBP sa Congress. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Karen S. Batu
turns.text: Opo. Opo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Okay. By just looking at it, may nakita ba kayong may mga mali? Or just by looking at it, na may mali?

turns.speaker: Atty. Karen S. Batu
turns.text: Hindi ko po talaga tinignan lahat ng mga nakalagay doon. Ang tinignan ko lang po kung tama yung years na hinihingi sa amin. Yun lang po yung sinabit kayo, Your Honor. But as to the contents, hindi po namin ni-review.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: So hindi niyo malalaman because repository lang po kayo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Karen S. Batu
turns.text: Yes po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Alright. Thank you po, Madam Witness.

turns.speaker: Atty. Karen S. Batu
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: There will be no further interjection. Yes, Senator-Judge Jontiveros.

turns.text: You

turns.text: Salamat po Madam Wittes. Mr. Presiding Officer, tanungin ko na lamang po muli ang defense at saka ang prosecution. So, if I may ask Atty. Justin, kung tama po ba na bawal yung collective declaration ng lahat ng personal properties na magkakaiba-ibang klase?

turns.text: keeping of the

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: reminder of the Presiding Officer.
